useful_delta: Recovered the strongest currently durable governing/method mechanisms and designed a compositional Constitution -> Active Method -> METHOD_HEAD architecture. The key gap is now explicit: Prometeo has binding Constitution, Survival Set, anti-limitation rules, execution profiles, deep/exhaustive protocols, scoped supersession, Context Foundry lineage and durable wake/recovery, but no canonical METHOD_HEAD/Active Method artifact that selects, composes, traces and enforces applicable method clauses. The proposed design reuses existing scope-aware Lineage supersession and Context Pack selection semantics instead of inventing latest-document-wins method storage.

facts.claim: The durable north star explicitly separates Constitution, Active Method, Product Memory, Project North, Campaign, Run, Return/Integration and Successor; stored memory is declared insufficient unless it governs execution.

The current Global Agent Constitution is already a real mandatory governing layer: preserve-first mutation, authority separation, EPOCH/CAS prewrite, active-writer collision law, evidence gates and finish-the-solvable-loop behavior are binding before material writes.

Current durable execution method is distributed across multiple artifacts rather than represented by one head. EXECUTION_PROFILES supplies FAST/DEEP/EXHAUSTIVE/CONTINUE; P4_CAPTURE_AGENT_PROTOCOL supplies authority reconstruction, exhaustive coverage, continuous execution, evidence/acceptance/release gates and dot semantics; AGENT_EXECUTION_PROTOCOL supplies worker lifecycle and preserve-first execution.

The Chat Object mission and success conditions require Active Method to govern successors, but CHAT_OBJECT.json currently has no active_method_ref or method_head_ref. Its reincarnation load-first set includes Big Picture, Anti-Limitation, Survival Set, FOCUS, Work Board and Shared Graph, not a canonical method head.

Direct inspection found no current METHOD_HEAD.json or ACTIVE_METHOD.json at the obvious control-plane/coordination paths. This is consistent with FOCUS naming Active Method vNext as future synthesis work rather than an already-live authority.

Prometeo already has the correct anti-latest-wins primitive to reuse: Part 2 defines scope-aware durable supersession, and Lineage currently records concrete supersession entries that replace an artifact only for a declared scope while preserving non-overlapping roles.

Prometeo already has the correct selection primitive to reuse: EXISTS != PARTICIPATES, HOT/WARM/COLD, Context Foundry and Context Pack compilation explicitly distinguish stored material from material selected into an active working set and require explainable inclusion/exclusion.

Durable wake/rehydration can reconstruct product truth without chat memory. P3-00 recovered Current, Human Accepted scopes, Served ceiling, capabilities, pending work, rules and HOT context in a clean process; this proves the substrate needed for method-head recovery exists, although method parity itself is not yet proven.

The Challenger/vaccine pattern has surviving concrete evidence: the Part 2 adversarial audit found blockers, repaired them and converted discovered failure modes into permanent known-disease/mutation regression coverage rather than merely producing critique prose.

The durable Big Picture identifies historical method ingredients R29 DAY_WORK, R31 Challenger, R38 4X/adaptive depth, R70 source plane, R77/R78 Written Mind/one-worker, R94 Airlock, CIP->dot->Forge, Book/Canon/Forge, Apprentice Reconstruction and traceability as mechanisms to compose. Exact original R-era source artifacts were not directly reopened by this run; current surviving descendants and durable registries were used rather than fabricating source closure.

authority_and_composition_model.principle: METHOD_HEAD is a canonical composition pointer/manifest, not a mega-prompt and not a second Constitution. Constitution defines non-negotiable law. Method registry stores reusable clauses/modules with provenance. METHOD_HEAD selects the accepted active set and its rollback lineage. A compiler derives the smallest applicable executable method for a concrete role/job/campaign/Working Set.
stack: GLOBAL_CONSTITUTION: small highest-order operating laws; changes require the strictest governance and must never be overridden by role/job prompts.
METHOD_CLAUSE_REGISTRY: append-only/lineaged reusable method clauses and modules with stable IDs, scope, authority, provenance, tests and status.
METHOD_SUPERSESSION: scope-aware replaces/conflicts/preserves records, adapting existing Lineage supersession semantics.
METHOD_HEAD: one canonical active-method head identifying the accepted clause/module set, constitution digest, coverage digest, compiler version, previous/rollback head and integration decision.
METHOD_COMPILER: Constitution + METHOD_HEAD + role/job + campaign/run phase + Working Set + applicable negative knowledge/vaccines -> COMPILED_METHOD_PACKET.

COMPILED_METHOD_PACKET: explicit included clause IDs/order/reasons, excluded high-relevance clauses/reasons, required gates, critic/test program, traceability and method-head identity; disposable and reproducible from durable inputs.
method_head_minimum_fields: coverage_basis: Survival Set + Big Picture + known diseases/vaccines digests

promotion_and_supersession_rules: No whole-document latest-wins promotion. Newer prompts/protocols are candidate sources; clauses enter the active set only through explicit head integration.
Every material clause change produces a coverage delta against current METHOD_HEAD, Global Constitution, Survival Set and relevant known diseases/vaccines.
Supersession must name exact old clause(s), exact scope/dimension, reason/evidence and what non-overlapping behavior remains preserved.
A broad new clause may not silently shadow a narrower high-authority clause. Same-scope high-authority contradictions surface as unresolved conflict instead of arbitrary priority.
Removing a clause is a first-class retirement decision with rationale, evidence, replacement/no-replacement and rollback lineage; omission from a new document is never retirement.
Material method changes receive a fresh Challenger/adversarial pass before promotion; constitution-changing proposals require even stricter owner/human/steward authority than normal method evolution.
METHOD_HEAD promotion is pointer movement to a tested composition, not mutation/deletion of historical clause sources.
Every compiler output records the exact METHOD_HEAD and clause IDs that governed execution so a result can be reproduced/audited.
compilation_rules: EXISTS != PARTICIPATES applies to method: registry presence does not mean a clause is active, and active-head membership does not mean every clause is injected into every worker.

Compile progressively: mandatory Constitution + always-on active clauses first; then role/job/profile/campaign-specific clauses; then conditional vaccines/negative knowledge triggered by affected capabilities.
Every included clause has an inclusion reason; every excluded high-relevance candidate has an exclusion reason, mirroring Context Pack explainability.
Profiles such as FAST/DEEP/EXHAUSTIVE/CONTINUE become composable modules selected by conditions rather than competing whole prompts.
Job text may specialize method but cannot suppress mandatory Constitution or active clauses unless METHOD_HEAD explicitly defines a permitted override boundary.
Fresh successor and original worker given identical durable inputs should compile the same governing clause IDs/order, modulo explicitly declared model/provider adaptation.
coverage_and_mutation_checks: CONSTITUTION_COVERAGE: each governing invariant is either directly mandatory or explicitly delegated to an active tested method clause; no silent gap.
SURVIVAL_COVERAGE: METHOD_HEAD maps all method-relevant Survival Set requirements to active clause IDs/modules or explicit N/A with reason.
REACHABILITY: every ACTIVE clause is reachable by at least one declared task/profile/applicability path; dormant accidental clauses fail linting.
SOURCE_CLOSURE: every active clause has reopenable provenance/authority and no dangling source ref.
CONTRADICTION: no unresolved same-scope active contradictions; high-authority conflicts fail closed.
SCOPED_SUPERSESSION: replacing clause A for scope X leaves A active for preserved scope Y and proves that with a test.
DETERMINISM: same head + same task metadata + same Working Set produces same ordered governing clause IDs and inclusion/exclusion rationale.
PROMPT_ERASURE: a short/new launch prompt that omits old method still compiles all applicable mandatory clauses.
POISONED_PROMPT: a worker/job asking to ignore previous rules cannot suppress Constitution/METHOD_HEAD constraints.
SUCCESSOR_PARITY: a fresh chat with no transcript reconstructs METHOD_HEAD and compiles equivalent governing method before material work.
MUTATION_KILL: deleting/altering each critical clause in a test fixture causes a coverage/falsification test to fail.
VACCINE_TRIGGER: relevant known-disease/incident guards are selected automatically for affected capability scopes.
TRACEABILITY: requirement -> method clause -> decision/change -> test/return can be followed in both directions.
ROLLBACK: previous METHOD_HEAD remains addressable and a head rollback restores the previous compiled clause set.
failure_modes: METHOD_HEAD degenerates into a giant copied mega-prompt and defeats progressive context.
A new protocol/document replaces an old one wholesale, silently deleting useful clauses.
Clauses are stored but compiler never selects them: memory exists but does not govern.
Supersession scope is too broad and deletes a useful historical role/capability.
Prompt/role text can override Constitution or mandatory active clauses.
METHOD_HEAD changes but EPOCH/compiled packets remain stale and workers execute old method unknowingly.
Two owners independently maintain competing method heads.
Candidate method advice self-promotes because a worker returned it or a newer commit exists.
Contradictory clauses are hidden behind arbitrary numeric priority instead of surfaced/reconciled.
Compiled method has no clause IDs/provenance, making audits and successor parity impossible.
Private/source-restricted method evidence leaks into public compiled coordination.
All jobs receive all method/history, turning Active Method into context flooding.
Self-improvement mutates the method without challenger, coverage delta or rollback point.
minimum_implementation_path: 1. Parent/steward consumes B-BIGPIC-01 returns first, because this scout is evidence/candidate only and the expansion board explicitly requires cross-return reconciliation before shared implementation.

2. Add candidate method schemas/artifacts under one canonical owner: METHOD_HEAD, CLAUSE_REGISTRY and METHOD_SUPERSESSION. Reuse/adapt Lineage scoped supersession semantics rather than create a second replacement model.
3. Add METHOD_COMPILER v1 that consumes Constitution + METHOD_HEAD + role/job/profile/campaign/Working Set and emits a traceable COMPILED_METHOD_PACKET with included/excluded reasons.
4. Add Chat Object active_method_ref/method_head_ref and runtime/packet projection so every reincarnation/worker can recover the current head without transcript or full-history reread.

5. Add method integration lifecycle: candidate clause delta -> coverage diff -> challenger/falsification -> steward decision -> new head + rollback pointer; keep Constitution changes on a stricter lane.

6. Add falsifying tests for prompt erasure, poisoned prompt, successor parity, scoped supersession, clause mutation, deterministic compilation, vaccine triggering and head freshness/EPOCH propagation.

7. Run a zero-memory method canary: fresh worker launched with only a tiny JOB address proves exact METHOD_HEAD identity, compiled clause IDs and one method-dependent behavior not present in the launch text. Only after that should Active Method be considered governing rather than merely stored.
